newer_changes_search: Web search (PIB, PMIndia, news) for NSAP changes: the Cabinet decision of 14 Oct 2026 (PIB Release 2323264, snapshot in content) continues NSAP 2026-27 to 2030-31 as Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana, renames the sub-schemes, revises the disability pension (Rs 375 / Rs 625, 40% benchmark disability, from birth, guidelines within three months) and continues the old-age, widow and family benefit schemes in their existing form. No revised disability-pension guidelines found as of 26 Oct 2026. The content already reflects the Cabinet decision and the transition period.

findings.note: Old-rule amounts now complete (Rs 300, Rs 500 from age 80), quoted from the guidelines; new Rs 375 / Rs 625 quoted from the Cabinet release. Text now third person. Hindi matches.

40% and 'from birth' rest on the Cabinet release (guidance is right). Until revised guidelines are issued, offices may still apply 80% and age 18+; a 40-79% applicant gets LIKELY_ELIGIBLE. The benefit text warns about this and reverify_days is 30.
findings.suggestion: Re-source to the revised MoRD guidelines (confirmed) when issued and drop the 'old rules' sentence.

findings.note: ration_card, bank_account and aadhaar now mandatory: false, consistent with guidelines para 5.2.12; disability_certificate mandatory is right. Rule text 'Has a disability' now matches q.disability.

Hard 'confirmed' rule on is_bpl, whose question asks about a BPL/Antyodaya ration card. Guidelines para 3.1.3 say an eligible person missing from the BPL list should not be left out; a 'no' gives a firm NOT_ELIGIBLE. how_to_apply mitigates this where it carries the note.
findings.suggestion: Consider confidence 'uncertain' so a 'no' shows 'check with the office'.

findings.note: The 2014 MoRD NSAP guidelines are cited from an official Odisha government copy (ssepd.odisha.gov.in), not nsap.dord.gov.in. Still the operative text for the parts used (Cabinet 2026: 'continue in its existing form').
findings.suggestion: Cite an nsap.dord.gov.in copy if one is available.
